question: The speed of a boat in still water is 9 km/hr and the speed of the stream is 5 km/hr. A man rows to a place at a distance of 75.6 km and comes back to the starting point. Find the total time (in hours) taken by him.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

**Downstream Speed** (D) = 9 + 5 = 14 km/hr

**Upstream Speed** (U) = 9 − 5 = 4 km/hr

Total Time = Distance × (1/D + 1/U) = 75.6 × (1/14 + 1/4)

Total Time = 75.6 × (18/56) = 24.3 hours

**∴ The correct answer is 24.3 hours.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Speed of **boat in still water** (x) = 9 km/hr

Speed of **stream** (y) = 5 km/hr

**Distance** (d) = 75.6 km

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a6dc4d6e9ef9972836625c50b596296a5b06ed20de5391d22c6aae9d096ee7f0.png] 

**Formula Used:**

Time = Distance ÷ Speed

Downstream Speed (Sd) = x + y

Upstream Speed (Sᵤ) = x − y

**Calculations:**

⇒ Downstream Speed = 9 + 5 = 14 km/hr

⇒ Upstream Speed = 9 − 5 = 4 km/hr

⇒ Downstream Time (t₁) = 75.6 ÷ 14 = 5.4 hours

⇒ Upstream Time (t₂) = 75.6 ÷ 4 = 18.9 hours

⇒ Total Time = t₁ + t₂ = 5.4 + 18.9 = 24.3 hours

**∴ The correct answer is 24.3 hours.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Still Water Speed Formula

Speed of boat in still water = (Downstream speed + Upstream speed) ÷ 2

Stream Speed Formula

Speed of current/stream = (Downstream speed − Upstream speed) ÷ 2

Average Speed in Boats and Streams

Average Speed for round trip = (Downstream speed × Upstream speed) ÷ Still water speed</p
